full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph shows an empty public hall beneath a sweeping lattice roof. The viewpoint is low and slightly off center, looking across a broad pale floor toward a distant back wall. Overhead, a dense grid of diagonal ribs spans the entire upper frame, curving downward from the left and right toward a bright central opening. The left side admits white daylight through many diamond-shaped cells; the right side falls into darker shadow, where the repeated ribs become a finer web. Near the middle, the ceiling's geometric grid compresses toward a luminous triangular area, creating a strong sense of structural depth. A thick pale curved support sweeps from the left wall toward the center, connecting the roof to the lower architecture. Along the floor, low counters or platforms form dark horizontal bands, one on the left and another more prominent at the right foreground. Slender posts and railings appear around them, but the hall remains largely unoccupied. A glass wall and a bright exterior glimpse sit at the rear right. The open ground plane carries subtle gray reflections and shadow patterns from the overhead lattice. Daylight from above and the far side provides the main light, making the left grid almost white while the right structural mass stays nearly black. The photograph preserves crisp lines and deep monochrome contrast, yet slight grain keeps the surfaces from looking digitally smooth. The recurring diagonal cells create visual rhythm at several scales, and their curvature pulls the eye toward the bright center. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition is monumental and quiet, using repeated structure, a wide empty floor, and controlled light to make engineering feel sculptural.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白建筑照片呈现一座空旷公共大厅，上方是横跨画面的曲面格构屋顶。视点低且略偏中心，越过宽阔浅色地面看向远处后墙。头顶密集斜肋网格占据整个上半幅，从左右向中央明亮开口弯垂。左侧日光穿过许多菱形格眼，显得明白；右侧落入较深阴影，重复肋条成为更细的网。在中央附近，屋顶几何网格向发亮三角形区域压缩，形成强烈结构纵深。一根粗浅色曲面支撑从左墙扫向中央，把屋顶接到下部结构。地面沿线，低矮台面或平台形成深色横带，左边一处，右前景另一处更醒目。周围可见细杆和栏杆，大厅仍大体无人。后方右侧有玻璃墙和一瞥明亮室外。开放地面承载细微灰色反光与格构投影。来自上方和远侧的日光是主光源，使左侧网格近乎白色，右侧结构体块仍接近黑色。照片保留清晰线条和深黑白对比，少许颗粒又避免表面显得数字式平滑。重复斜格以多种尺度建立节奏，弯曲走势把视线拉向明亮中央。没有人物或可读文字。整体构图宏伟而安静，借重复结构、宽阔空地和受控光线让工程造形具有雕塑感。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome photography emphasizes repeated diagonal geometry, sweeping curvature, and a wide interval between black and white. Gridded lines multiply toward a bright focal opening, so density and scale change carry a strong sense of depth. One side admits luminous diffuse light while the opposite side holds a heavy dark mass, making contrast both structural and atmospheric. Broad smooth planes below allow the intricate upper pattern to breathe; low horizontal bands anchor the frame without competing with it. Crisp edges preserve the precision of the repeating cells, while faint grain and soft reflected light keep the image tactile. Perspective gathers the many lines into a controlled convergence rather than an undifferentiated mesh. Sparse middle-gray surfaces link brilliant highlights to deep shadow. The overall effect is austere, expansive, and sculptural, with geometry and light acting as the main visual subjects.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影强调重复的斜向几何、横扫的曲率和宽阔黑白跨度。格状线条向明亮焦点开口倍增，密度与尺度的变化承载强烈纵深。一侧引入发亮漫光，对侧留着厚重暗体块，使对比同时成为结构与气氛。下部宽阔平滑区域给上方复杂纹样呼吸空间；低位水平带稳定画面却不争夺注意。清晰边缘保留重复网格的精度，细颗粒和柔反光则让图像有触感。透视把众多线汇向受控聚点，而非混成无分别的网。少量中灰表面连接耀眼亮部和深影。整体效果严峻、开阔且有雕塑感，几何与光成为主要视觉内容。
theme_en: An empty hall beneath a sweeping black-and-white lattice roof
theme_zh: 一座空旷大厅位于黑白格构曲面屋顶之下
name: Pier Luigi Nervi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
